reviewer: Pickle: 한국소비자원 커피그라인더 8종 시험의 분쇄범위·잔류량·분쇄시간·소음·농도·에너지·개선권고 수치, 커피농도 기준, 쿠팡 3종 판매 조건
method: Reviewed the draft against the 25 recorded facts and 6 citations on 2026-11-20. Primary source: the KCA consumer24 comparison page for coffee grinders (infoId=A1081393, posted 2026-08-13) and its attachment PDFs, opened directly. Attachment 1 gives the selection basis: 500 consumers who bought or used a grinder in the previous two years surveyed in January 2026, brands under 400,000 won, four conical and four flat burr models, with the January 2026 online purchase prices 45,000 (Comac CG-1501PB), 65,000 (Braun KG7070), 121,000 (Cuckoo CCG-ACJ2510S), 170,000 (Hario EVCN-8B-KEX), 235,980 (DeLonghi KG520.M), 285,000 (Delico CRM9015), 300,000 (Breville BCG600) and 330,000 won (Fema 601NProMattBlack), and the test methods for noise (KS C IEC 60704-2-11) and safety (KC 60335-2-14). Attachment 2 gives the per-product tables I used: grind range minimum and maximum in micrometres, the width differences quoted as 960 to 2,535 micrometres in the 2.6-fold sentence, the minimum particle of 1,103 micrometres for the Comac against the 600 micrometre espresso threshold, the mid-setting particle sizes (666 to 1,698) and TDS values (1.1 to 2.0 percent), the residue percentages of 1, 3, 4, 8, 16, 19 and 20 with the note that the middle setting leaves 4 percent or less in every product, the grind times per stage (coarse 8 to 33 seconds: DeLonghi 8, Fema 9, Breville and Hario 11, Comac and Delico 14, Cuckoo 17, Braun 33; finest 17 to 60 seconds: Comac 17, DeLonghi 19, Fema 27, Breville 28, Delico 33, Braun 44, Cuckoo 50, Hario 60), the sound power levels (Cuckoo 77, DeLonghi, Breville, Braun and Delico 79, Comac 81, Fema 82, Hario 83 decibels, with the 3 decibel doubling note and the cordless vacuum range 72 to 79 and 80 to 83), the power figures (88 to 146, 63 to 165 and 49 to 120 watts by stage), the statement that a single run costs under one won, and the improvement recommendations to Braun (unground beans jumping), Comac (hopper lid fixation causing a stop), Fema and Delico (operating with the lid unlatched) and Breville (burr contact at the finest setting), with the four suppliers and Breville Korea replying. The reference page in the same PDF supplies the brew-method particle bands (600 micrometres or less for espresso, 500 to 1,200 for hand drip, 1,000 and above for cold brew), the 9 bar 20 to 30 second espresso description, and the SCA TDS bands of 1.2 and 1.5 percent with the Golden Cup Zone. The main page supplies the 93 degree, 1 to 15 ratio, 20 gram test condition, the 67.8 and 26.6 percent survey answer on grind settings, and the espresso 20 to 30 second note. My own arithmetic is recorded in the research file: annual beans of 13,140 grams from 36 grams a day, 2.5 kilograms and about 59,918 won at 24,000 won per kilogram, 730 grinds a year turning 60 and 17 seconds into 12.2 and 3.4 hours, 1.375 watt-hours per 30 second run and about 21 won a month at 250 won per kilowatt-hour, the 7.3-fold price spread, and the 28.9 percent rise and 39.4 percent fall against the January 2026 test prices. Products: the three Coupang pages were opened in the browser on 2026-11-20 and showed Comac CG-1501PB at 58,000 won with free shipping, arrival on 24 November and 890 reviews at 4.5; Braun KG7070 at 65,300 won from 99,900 won after a 34 percent discount that the page conditions on Shinhan, Woori, NongHyup, Hana or Samsung card payment, free shipping and returns, next-day arrival and 206 reviews at 4.5; and Cuckoo CCG-ACJ2510S at 73,340 won from 111,120 won with a 10,000 won Wow coupon, free shipping and returns, next-day arrival and 47 reviews at 5.0. Affiliate deep links were built from each pageKey, itemId and vendorItemId and each returned a 302 to the matching product. Gate score 94/100 with 195 of 203 numbers backed by the research file.
